content_sections.heading: DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Delhi Transco Limited (DTL) has officially released the recruitment notification dated 17 August 2026 for the engagement of 65 Assistant Manager Trainee vacancies, including Assistant Manager (T) Trainee-Electrical, Assistant Manager (T) Trainee-Non-Electrical and Assistant Manager (Civil) Trainee posts. The notification includes complete details on vacancy distribution, GATE 2026 paper code requirements, educational qualifications, age limit, application fee, salary, selection process, one-year training, service bond, and application instructions. Candidates are advised to read the complete notification carefully before applying. The notification is available on the official DTL website. content_sections.heading: DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: DTL has notified 65 vacancies across three disciplines, with category-wise reservation as per Government norms. Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) also applies. For Asstt. Manager (T)-Trainee, identified disabilities include HH, and OL/Dw/AAV/SD/SI, along with MD involving these categories. For Asstt. Manager (Civil)-Trainee, identified disabilities include HH, and OA/OL/LC/Dw/AAV/SD/SI, along with MD involving these categories.

content_sections.heading: DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Any additional equivalent qualification will be decided solely by a committee constituted by the Managing Director, DTL, whose decision is final. Only qualifications recognized by AICTE or the appropriate statutory authority, and declared equivalent in writing, will be accepted. Asstt. Manager (T) Trainee-Electrical requires a valid GATE 2026 score in Paper Code EE (Electrical Engineering or equivalent). Asstt. Manager (T) Trainee-Non-Electrical requires a valid GATE 2026 score in Paper Code EC (Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent) and/or CS (Computer Science & Engineering/Information Technology or equivalent), as applicable. Asstt. Manager (Civil) Trainee requires a valid GATE 2026 score in Paper Code CE (Civil Engineering or equivalent).

rows.educational_qualification: Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University or equivalent (Electrical/Electrical (Power)/Electrical and Electronics/Power Systems Engineering/Power Engineering (Electrical))
Degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering/Information Technology/Computer Science & Engineering from a recognized University or equivalent

Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or equivalent. Desirable: two years of experience in design and construction of reinforced concrete structures, heavy machine foundations and masonry structures

content_sections.heading: DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit must not exceed 28 years as on the last date for receipt of applications. Only Indian Nationals below 28 years of age are eligible to apply. Further relaxations will apply as per Government norms in force on the last date of application. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly

content_sections.heading: DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Application Fee
content_sections.text: The Demand Draft must be in favour of Delhi Transco Limited and payable at New Delhi. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before paying the registration fee.

content_sections.heading: DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed as Asstt. Manager (T) Trainee/Asstt. Manager (Civil) Trainee in Pay Level-09 with Central DA pattern and other allowances such as House Rent/Accommodation/Conveyance Facility/Medical/LTC, as per company rules. On successful completion of the one-year training, candidates will be absorbed as Assistant Manager (T)/Assistant Manager (Civil) in Pay Level-10, with the same set of Central DA pattern allowances. Selected candidates must execute a service agreement bond to complete the training period and serve the organization for at least three years. The bond amount is INR 5,00,000/- for General/OBC(NCL)/EWS candidates and INR 2,50,000/- for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.

content_sections.heading: DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for all three posts is made purely on the basis of GATE 2026 scores in the respective discipline/paper code - no separate written test or interview is mentioned in the notification. Separate merit lists are prepared for Asstt. Manager (T) Trainee-Electrical, Asstt. Manager (T) Trainee-Non-Electrical, and Asstt. Manager (Civil) Trainee. Final selection is based on merit derived from the GATE 2026 score (Normalized Marks out of 100), as per approved selection criteria. Inter-se seniority of appointed Assistant Manager (Technical) candidates is regulated in a 9:1 ratio between the Electrical and Non-Electrical streams. Selected candidates undergo one year of training, split into 3 months of academic training (through NPTI or another training institute as per DTL policy) and 9 months of field/on-the-job training in DTL substations/offices. Candidates must score a minimum of 65% marks in the training examination and in the final assessment for absorption. Those who do not qualify will not be absorbed into DTL and may represent to the Director (HR) within 15 days.

Manager (HR) Recruitment, Delhi Transco Limited, 06th Floor, Shakti Sadan, Kotla Road, New Delhi-110002. The envelope should be marked as "Application for the post of Asstt. Manager (T)-Trainee Electrical/ Asstt. Manager (T)-Trainee Non-Electrical/ Asstt. Manager (Civil)-Trainee," as applicable. Before registering, candidates should keep ready a valid self email ID, mobile number, scanned photograph, scanned signature, Demand Draft number, and GATE 2026 marks. No manual/paper-only application (without the online step) will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Recruitment 2026?

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A relevant engineering degree (Electrical, Electronics & Communication/IT/Computer Science, or Civil, depending on the post) from a recognized University, along with a valid GATE 2026 score in the corresponding paper code.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on the last date for receipt of applications, with age relaxation for SC/ST, OBC (NCL), PwBD, and other categories as per Government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 500/- (non-refundable) through Demand Draft. SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through www.dtl.gov.in and also send a hardcopy of the application along with the required documents via Speed Post to the DTL HR Recruitment address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DTL Assistant Manager Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based entirely on GATE 2026 normalized scores in the relevant paper code, followed by one year of training with qualifying marks of 65% required for final absorption.
